nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.source_overview: All 18 paintings inspected; pixel-identical to prior half-strength control.
nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.native_final: Inspected earlier control final and confirmed new source pixels identical.
nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.first_interval: All 4 frames inspected; no gross doubled main silhouette.
nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.delivery: Both pair and full moving-tail MP4s byte-identical to prior screened delivery.
nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.observations: Planet retained, fine pits enlarge into round holes, foreground smooths; same transient extra small moon as prior control.
nr-ref-tidal-edit050-repeat.selection: Previously human-preferred control retained for comparison; subsequent feedback favors 0.25.

nr-ref-tidal-edit025.native: Paintings 6, 10 and 17 inspected at native resolution.
nr-ref-tidal-edit025.dense: All four first-interval frames; 0.50-0.75s and 1.50-1.75s all 14 frames; extra sky-event interval 0.875-1.25s all 10 frames.
nr-ref-tidal-edit025.observations: Cooler than 0.5; main ringed planet retained; large added moon grows early and persists. Smaller moon appears near 0.875s, disappears around 1.08s and later returns. Shell becomes more regular honeycomb and foreground grows rocks. Surface grain still simplifies; clean contours are not proof of more detail. No gross doubled major silhouette in inspected RIFE intervals.
nr-ref-tidal-edit025.selection: Human likes this variant; current preferred adapter candidate for this scene.

nr-ref-tidal-edit075.native: Paintings 7 and 17 inspected at native resolution.
nr-ref-tidal-edit075.dense: All 4 first-interval frames and all 14 frames in 0.50-0.75s and 1.50-1.75s.
nr-ref-tidal-edit075.observations: Main planet retained, no extra moons observed in the 18 paintings. Fewer, larger smooth shell folds and less honeycomb redesign than 0.25. Stronger amber treatment than 0.5, shell exterior becomes rust-colored, spires become glossy and terrain grain smooths. No gross doubled major silhouettes in inspected RIFE intervals.
nr-ref-tidal-edit075.selection: Available preservation/color tradeoff, not shortlisted as detail improvement.

nr-sampler-tidal-euler060-repeat.source_overview: All 18 paintings verified pixel-identical to prior screened Euler 0.60 control.
nr-sampler-tidal-euler060-repeat.native: Original matching native final inspected this session.
nr-sampler-tidal-euler060-repeat.delivery: Full moving-tail and pair MP4 byte-identical to prior screened deliveries; reuse that complete source/dense-window screening.
nr-sampler-tidal-euler060-repeat.observations: Main planet retained, reflection fills out, small shell pits enlarge and terrain smooths. Cooler than reference-editing branches.

nr-sampler-tidal-heun060.native: Paintings 6 and 17 inspected at native resolution; painting 6 compared directly with Euler.
nr-sampler-tidal-heun060.dense: All 4 first-interval frames, all 14 frames in 0.50-0.75s and 1.50-1.75s.
nr-sampler-tidal-heun060.observations: Main ringed planet remains; reflection fills into a full orb. More scattered dots, orange flecks and small pits appear on shell, ground and water; dense stars and reflected specks accumulate. Shell folds become more wavy and terrain edges more graphic. Added marks do not read as convincing fine mineral texture. No clear preservation/detail win over Euler despite two extra model evaluations per painting. No gross doubled major silhouette in screened RIFE windows.
nr-sampler-tidal-heun060.selection: Retain as a creative alternative following human review; no strict superiority over baseline claimed. Assistant fine-detail observations do not establish overall artistic preference.

nr-sampler-tidal-dpmpp2m060.native: Final painting inspected at native resolution.
nr-sampler-tidal-dpmpp2m060.dense: All 4 first-interval frames, all 14 frames in 0.50-0.75s and 1.50-1.75s.
nr-sampler-tidal-dpmpp2m060.observations: Main ringed planet remains; lower crescent/reflection becomes a full orb. Shell layers become wavy and flatter, with more graphic dark and rust streaks. More small pits, dots and thin spires develop, some spires gain rounded tips. Edges can be crisp, but this is shape/mark invention rather than retention of original fine mineral relief. No clear fidelity gain over Euler; greater redesign than Heun by the end. No gross doubled major silhouette in screened RIFE windows.
nr-sampler-tidal-dpmpp2m060.selection: Retain as a creative alternative following human review; no strict superiority over baseline claimed. Assistant fine-detail observations do not establish overall artistic preference.

No sampler/adapter combination tested and no production film replaced.
